messages.author: 7a5c2ea68524e713
messages.subject: Student Proposal Deadline on Friday
parts:
Dear all,

the student proposal deadline is on Friday. Let's all use the time to
get good proposals up.
This includes the mentors starting to comment on the complete proposals,
so that students have time to react to the questions/suggestions of
other mentors.

Students who did not yet upload a complete proposal, please do that as
soon as possible. The remaining days are extremely important for
improvement of the proposals.
Please everyone use some kind of the same name both in gsoc-r and the
proposals - I have to admit that I have no idea of how names are
abbreviated in non-european languages, and my knowledge of slavik
abbreviations is kind of superficial. Remember, most of us are not known
to each other and the melange program is confusing enough without always
wondering who's who. ;-)

Possible mentors and co-mentors, please go to "your" proposals and click
"I want to mentor this project" so we can see that all proposals have
their proper mentors assigned.


Claudia

what are the criteria?

Thanks,
